name: obs-neutral-balance
initializeCommand: df /var/lib/docker | awk 'NR==2{print $5}' | grep -q '9[0-9]%' && echo 'docker.img nearly full' && exit 1 || true
postStartCommand: test -d /workspaces/libobs-install || echo 'NOTE: libobs build tree missing — ask Cline to build OBS 31.1.1 per CI workflow'
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y qt6-base-dev libgl1-mesa-dev && git config --global --add safe.directory ${containerWorkspaceFolder}
